Use this data source to get the available regions. By default only `AVAILABLE` regions will be returned, but `UNAVAILABLE` regions can also be fetched when `includeUnavailable` is specified.

            title="Required">
        <span id="name_yaml">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#name_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>When specified, only the region with the exactly name match will be returned. <code>default</code> value means it consistent with the provider region.</dd><dt class="property-required"
            title="Required">

<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#state_yaml" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">state</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The state of the region, indicate availability using <code>AVAILABLE</code> and <code>UNAVAILABLE</code> values.</dd></dl>
